summary: Unexpected invoice charge for March 2026 - needs clarification
description:
Customer reports an unexpectedly large invoice for March 2026 (Invoice INV-2026-03-1187). Expected AR charge for committed Dedicated capacity was $1,245.00; invoice shows $12,450.00. Impact: finance/AR has placed a payment hold and accounting needs a corrected invoice/credit note.

Steps to reproduce / observed details:
1) Customer (Fjord Analytics) viewed Console > Billing > Invoices and downloaded INV-2026-03-1187 PDF.
2) Line items show two identical 'dedicated-reservation' line items (each $6,225.00) which looks like a duplicate.
3) Console usage dashboard for March shows committed capacity usage consistent with expectation (approx 100k tokens/day), not 10x.
4) API request logs for customer account_id fjord-9987 show no anomalous traffic spikes on 2026-03-02..2026-03-31.

What customer asks: Please validate whether this was a billing system duplication, confirm if a credit will be issued or if an amended invoice will be reissued, and provide ETA. They attached the invoice PDF and the account billing export (attached as invoice_INV-2026-03-1187.pdf, billing_export_fjord-9987-2026-03.csv).

Initial hypothesis: possible duplicate reservation line created during re-run of invoice generation job or a merge of two billing runs. Alternatively, a migration bug where a legacy charge was re-applied. Needs billing/finance review and engineering verification of invoice generation job for March run.

2026-03-04 10:20 - Liam Patel (Billing): "Acknowledged — assigning to finance ops and ENG-billing. Initial look: invoice generation job completed at 2026-03-01 02:14 UTC. I'll pull the raw run file and compare."

2026-03-05 14:08 - Nora Diaz (ENG-billing): "I pulled the invoice run artifacts. There is an unexpected duplicate reservation_id present in the March aggregation for account fjord-9987. Looks like two reservation rows were merged without dedupe after a retry. Investigating upstream job that produces reservation aggregates."
2026-03-06 11:55 - Finance Ops (TBD): "We can issue a provisional credit while ENG confirms root cause. Need approval from accounting manager."

2026-03-09 15:02 - Liam Patel (Billing): "Root cause narrowed to invoice-run retry with non-idempotent aggregation; engineering has a patch in review to dedupe by reservation_id. Finance prepared a credit memo draft. ETA for patch to prod and re-run: 2026-03-12."
2026-03-10 08:44 - Customer (Maya Patel): "Thank you. Please send the credit memo and corrected invoice as soon as available. We also need a short explanation we can share internally."
resolution_notes: Provisional credit approved pending ENG patch. ENG to merge dedupe fix and re-run invoice generation for affected accounts. Finance to issue corrected invoice and credit memo once run completes.
